newsitem.title: CHINA: SWIRE FALLS AFTER DISAPPOINTING INTERIMS.
newsitem.headline: SWIRE FALLS AFTER DISAPPOINTING INTERIMS.

text.p: Shares of Swire Pacific Ltd fell on disappointed selling after the company reported single-digit growth in interim earnings, brokers said on Thursday.

"People were taking profit after the company reported a disappointing earnings report," said Anthony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas. "The market generally expected a double digit growth but it turned out to be a single digit."
Swire shares fell HK$2.25 to HK$72.75 in late trade on volume of 4.04 million shares worth HK$304.71 million.
Swire reported a 8.5 percent rise in net profit to HK$3.32 billion for the six months to June 30.
It said it expected further enhancement of property profits during the second half of 1997 due to sales of residential development properties and growth in net rental income.
